date_scope_check.qualification: The 23 March date is a latest-confirmed national marker, not an exact first Sadao closure. An indexed Songkhla policy report points to 21 March, but original access and first gate-level denial remain unresolved. The 739-day difference from the selected marker is not a complete observed closure length. Limited Thai returns and freight continued; 1 April 2022 is the Sadao passenger pilot endpoint, not unrestricted entry or every Thai post.
